g.text: State Flow: INITIALIZING → IDLE → [ANIMATING | VOICE_FOLLOWING | PETTING | COLLISION_AVOIDING] → IDLE
Nodes → StateManagerNode → Priority Resolution → State Broadcast → Coordinated Actions
Sensors → BehaviorCoordinator → Mixin Behaviors → Hardware Interface → State Updates
Camera → Emotion Detection → Priority Request → State Manager → Animation → Completion
Touch/Proximity → Severity Analysis → Escape Logic → State Coordination → Recovery
ReSpeaker → DOA/VAD → Voice Behavior → Hardware Control → Face Detection Variations
State Changes → NeoPixel Controller → State-specific Animations → Visual Feedback
Priority-based coordination, completion transitions, node health monitoring
Mixin-based behaviors (Collision, Idle, Voice, Petting) with shared utilities
Robust serial communication with error recovery and position feedback
NeoPixel state visualization with animation timing and override protection
Multi-modal sensor fusion with I2C device management and gesture recognition
DOA estimation, VAD processing, and face detection integration
DEMA with movement source tracking and intelligent collision avoidance
Real-time diagnostics, performance metrics, and thermal protection

svg.text: Architecture v2.0 - Updated with Centralized State Management
